single_lane_method_paragraph: H86M-BMGS fits an out-of-quadrant (quad != q) 2-D FFT upward-continued Athy-compacted basin-fill mass-balance gravity regression removing Cenozoic sediment thickness (Band 15 at z=200 m and 800 m plus compaction Z_b^2/(Z_b+1200 m) and regional z=4000 m baseline) from isostatic gravity (Band 13) to isolate intrabasin horst/relay basement density steps, Laplace g_zz zero-crossing sharpness, and vector gradient discordance against observed (B18, -B11); pairs this with an 8-azimuth steerable quadrature odd-step vs even-dike filter bank relu(|O_theta| - 0.85|E_theta|) on flight-seam-vetoed RTP (Band 2) and BMR gravity, directional conductance-neck bridges (Band 17) gated by positive geodetic dilatation/shear (Bands 8, 7), dilatation-gated shallow footwall pullback (<=3.0 px max shift, leaving steep/strike-slip contacts unshifted), seam-vetoed GeoDAWN K/eTh & U/eTh steps, 10 m DEM quantile-debiased 3DEP 1 m LiDAR + fluvial chi knickzones, and up-hydraulic-head DOE GDR #1391 Fournier silica/cation thermal disequilibrium + 2-m probe thermal walls + paleo-sinter vents (strictly banning dist_known_fault_px and excluding raw Bands 12/19 from the cover-blind specialist). Calibrated via Elkan (2001) Bayes subsampling odds with zero-label quadrant-median alignment, sharpened by 8-azimuth axial geodesic strand coherence along local strike theta_hat, and fused via Noisy-OR with cross-component 4-fold LOQO fracture mechanics, H86M-BMGS allocates 37,654 unit dots (d_min=2.8 px, collar >3.0 px) via Exact 6-Ring Bernoulli Survival Supremum Self-Credit Dinkelbach Fractional-Programming CELF.
